description: List stored scans, newest first, with their finding, critical and high counts. The response is windowed: limit is the page size (default 10, capped at 100) and offset selects the page; the page object states total, hasMore and nextOffset. Scan IDs can be passed to vigil_explain, vigil_fix, vigil_report and vigil_verify.

limit.description: Maximum number of scans in this window (default 10, capped at 100).

offset.description: Zero-based scan offset for paging. Start with 0, then pass page.nextOffset from the previous result.

name: vigil_history
title: List stored Vigil scans
